items.q: What does a website at SaaleWeb cost?
items.a: A landing page starts at €990, company websites at €1,990. You always get a transparent fixed price after a free initial call.
A landing page is often ready in 1–2 weeks, a full company website in 3–5 weeks — depending on scope and content.
Yes. SEO is part of every website from the start — technical, content and local — so you're found on Google and in AI search.
We structure your content so that ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Perplexity can understand, cite and recommend your business.
From the Business package you get a simple CMS to update texts, images and blog posts yourself.

items.q: Do you offer hosting and maintenance?
items.a: Yes. We host on Vercel (lightning-fast and secure) and offer optional maintenance with updates, monitoring and support.

faq.q: How much does a website cost?
faq.a: It depends on the scope. A modern business site starts in a clearly calculable range — transparent and with no hidden costs. In the free first call we give you a fixed price. You'll also find concrete packages on our pricing page.
Most projects go live in 3 to 6 weeks. The pace mainly depends on the content — and we actively help you prepare it.

faq.q: Can I edit the content myself later?
faq.a: Yes. You get a simple admin area to manage texts, images, prices and posts yourself — no technical knowledge required.

faq.q: Does the website really belong to me?
faq.a: 100 %. The code, content and domain are yours. No lock-in to website builders and no hidden licence fees.

faq.q: Do you support me after launch?
faq.a: Happily. On request we handle updates, security, backups and ongoing optimisation so your site keeps bringing enquiries.
